d: Some creatures leave behind little more than mysterious sightings, unusual footprints and stories that refuse to disappear! Wildlife biologist Forrest Galante travels into remote habitats in search of rare species believed to be extinct or lost to the wild. From the elusive Formosan Clouded Leopard and the White Wolf of Newfoundland to the Florida Black Panther, Zanzibar Leopard, Great Auk, Pachylemur and Dingo, each investigation raises a fascinating question: could these animals still exist?
